findings.evidence: The in-app Browser focused the native summary element but did not expose reliable default Enter or Space activation through its synthetic key dispatcher.
findings.impact: Pointer disclosure and native details-summary semantics are verified; synthesized keyboard activation is not claimed.
findings.fix: Retained the native details-summary control and recorded the harness limitation for a future real-browser assistive-technology pass.

findings.evidence: The local harness does not open native mail clients or prove inbox receipt.
findings.impact: Mailto destinations are exact but external delivery remains unverified.
findings.fix: Kept visible contact@furcode.com.ar and talent@furcode.com.ar fallback addresses in the footer.

residual_risks: Native keyboard activation should be repeated in a real browser or assistive-technology pass if release policy requires interaction proof beyond native semantics.
Native mail-client handoff, inbox receipt and deployed production behavior remain outside local evidence.
